harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built the required cross-vendor transit topology (node3 -- lan-a -- node1[VyOS] -- transit -- node2[OPNsense] -- lan-b -- node4) and opened exactly one path: node3 -> node4:8080/tcp, while all other transit traffic between lan-a and lan-b remains refused by both routers' default-deny forward/filter policies. Then executed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes with pre/post evidence.
actions_performed: Discovered physical NIC pairing by testing IPs/ping between candidate interfaces: node1 eth1<->node2 vtnet1 (transit), node1 eth2<->node3 enp8s0 (lan-a), node2 vtnet2<->node4 enp8s0 (lan-b)
Addressed transit 10.10.10.0/24 (node1 eth1=.254, node2 vtnet1=.2), lan-a 10.10.20.0/24 (node1 eth2=.1, node3 enp8s0=.12), lan-b 10.10.30.0/24 (node2 vtnet2=.254, node4 enp8s0=.13)

On node1 (VyOS): set static route 10.10.30.0/24 via 10.10.10.2; set firewall ipv4 forward filter default-action drop, rule 5 accept established/related, rule 10 accept tcp dst 10.10.30.13:8080 src 10.10.20.0/24 ingress eth2; committed and saved

On node2 (OPNsense): assigned opt1 (vtnet1, transit) and opt2 (vtnet2, lan-b) interfaces in config.xml, added GW_TRANSIT gateway + static route to 10.10.20.0/24, added legacy filter pass rule for tcp/8080 from 10.10.20.0/24 to 10.10.30.13 on opt1; applied via configctl interface reconfigure and filter reload; verified pf ruleset shows default-deny plus the one quick-pass rule and mgmt SSH pass rule untouched
On node3/node4: configured static IPs and cross-subnet static routes persistently via nmcli (NetworkManager) so they survive reboot

Diagnosed and fixed a red herring: instant EHOSTUNREACH on node3 was firewalld's default-deny INPUT reject (admin-prohibited) on node4, not a routing/NAT problem; opened tcp/8080 via firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=8080/tcp and reloaded
Deployed the HTTP test service on node4 as a persistent systemd unit (demo-http.service, bound to 10.10.30.13:8080) so it survives reboot
Verified end-to-end: node3 HTTP GET to node4:8080 succeeds; ping and port 80 from node3 to node4 both fail (refused)
Captured pre-restart boot identity (boot_id / kern.boottime) and health baseline on all 4 nodes

Restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 one at a time (native reboot mechanisms: sudo reboot / shutdown -r now / systemctl reboot), polled each until exec was available again, and confirmed a changed boot identity on each before proceeding to the next node
After each restart, verified config persistence (interfaces, routes, firewall/pf rules, demo-http service, firewalld port) and re-ran the end-to-end flow test (8080 works, ping/port80 refused)

evidence.requirement: Only node3->node4:8080/tcp is open across the transit path; other traffic refused
evidence.summary: pfctl -s rules shows default block-all plus one quick-pass rule for tcp/8080 from lan-a to node4; curl to 8080 succeeds while ping and port 80 both fail from node3

evidence.requirement: VyOS (node1) forward filter default-deny with explicit allow for the required flow, persisted
evidence.summary: show firewall ipv4 forward filter displays default-action drop, established/related rule, and the tcp/8080 rule; identical ruleset with hit counters present after reboot

evidence.requirement: OPNsense (node2) opt interfaces, static route, and pf pass rule for the flow, persisted
evidence.summary: opt1/opt2 assigned and reloaded, filter reloaded, pf rule for tcp/8080 present; after reboot, netstat -rn and pfctl -s rules show interfaces, routes, and the rule all intact

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id 2eb8b6e8... before reboot; reboot acknowledged; boot_id 2f56f740... after; firewall/routes/interfaces intact; node3->node4:8080 curl succeeded post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: kern.boottime sec=1788671155 before, sec=1788671913 after reboot (changed); interfaces/routes/pf rule verified intact; end-to-end curl succeeded and ping still correctly refused post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id f7db4b4e... before, fd71c8d4... after reboot; static IP and route to lan-b restored via NetworkManager persistence; curl to node4:8080 succeeded post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state (service + firewall)
evidence.summary: boot_id df8bab0d... before, 5dce350e... after reboot; demo-http.service active and listening, firewalld port 8080/tcp open, static IP/route restored; full flow re-verified from node3 post-reboot (8080 works, ping/port80 refused)
